gaps.explanation: p5 governmental funds statement prints Transfer General 30,000 and ARPA (39,777); the Total Governmental Funds column nets them to (9,777), which is the JSON transfers_out. Detail records them gross (General Fund Fire 15,000 + City Hall 15,000 in; ARPA Fund -39,777 out, p12/p15), so schedule out 39,777 vs statement net 9,777. Gross vs net only; no fix.

No proprietary schedule; p7 proprietary statement prints Electric, Water, Sewer, Garbage columns. JSON business-type receipts = Charges for services 871,517 + Other 23,252 + Interest income 7,544 + Issuance of debt 580,000 = 1,482,313. Added per column: Electric 653,359 + 22,827 + 6,122 = 682,308; Water 128,172 + 425 + 925 + 580,000 = 709,522; Sewer 53,501; Garbage 36,485 + 497 = 36,982. Sum 1,482,313 = statement.
